issues.description: The problem statement and UML refer to an interface named 'Rideable' (with method messageOnRide()), but the solution repository introduces an interface named 'Mountable' and has classes (Pig, Seal) implement Mountable. Additionally, Rideable.java in the solution is empty. This naming mismatch between 'Rideable' and 'Mountable' (and the empty Rideable.java) makes it unclear which interface students should implement and may confuse mapping the UML/description to the provided solution code.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the interface name across artifacts. Either rename Mountable.java and its usages in the solution to Rideable (and remove or populate Rideable.java accordingly), or update the problem statement/UML to use 'Mountable' consistently. Ensure the interface file Rideable.java (or Mountable.java) declares the messageOnRide() method and that Pig and Seal implement that same interface name.
